snippet.title: Deep Blue Sushi - Official Game Announcement!
snippet.description:
🍣 WISHLIST DEEP BLUE SUSHI ON STEAM!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4005220/Deep_Blue_Sushi/

🌊 Deep Blue Sushi is a 1–5 player co-op ocean exploration and sushi restaurant management game. 

Players dive into a mysterious ocean to hunt fresh fish, return to their seaside restaurant, prepare sushi, serve customers, upgrade their diving equipment, and gradually explore deeper and more dangerous waters.

🎮 KEY FEATURES

• 👥 1–5 player online co-op
• 🎣 Dive into the ocean and hunt fish with your harpoon
• 🍣 Prepare sushi and serve hungry customers
• 🦈 Explore deeper waters filled with dangerous creatures
• 🤿 Upgrade your diving equipment and reach greater depths
• 🏮 Expand and improve your seaside sushi restaurant
• 🧭 Uncover the secrets of the mysterious Deep Blue

📅 RELEASE DATE
August 20, 2026

 📸 Press kit (trailer, screenshots, logo, key art etc.): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17EuLI4HATR9eqQfsfUAZSn1EwwEnok0-?usp=drive_link

Developed by Paper Pixel Games

#DeepBlueSushi #IndieGame #CoopGames #SushiGame #SteamGames #MultiplayerGames
